description: Set the per-variant speaker notes for a slide. Required: slide_id, variant_id. Optional: speaker_text, seconds (planned duration), bullets (array of cue points), direction (Regie), demo_points (array), insert_clip, bullets_confirmed. Writing notes clears the slide's stale flag for this variant. Returns { note_id }.

bullets.description: Cue points for the cue card

bullets_confirmed.description: true = the bullets have been checked and confirmed

demo_points.description: Demo points to show on this slide

insert_clip.description: Clip to insert at this slide

seconds.description: Planned duration of the slide in seconds

speaker_text.description: Full speaker text for this slide in this variant

name: set_slide_notes
